historical_record.description: The property then held an existing, vacant industrial building.
The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization to allow construction of two dwelling units, 6-0.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved demolition of the vacant industrial building and construction of housing and production, distribution and repair space, with the women's bathroom moved next to the men's bathroom and the wet bar moved into the office, 6-0.

The City Planning Commission disapproved the conditional use to demolish an existing industrial building and construct one additional dwelling unit for a total of three units, final action after the April 11, 2002 intent to disapprove.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and disapproved the project to demolish an existing industrial building and construct one additional dwelling unit for a total of three units, final action after the April 11, 2002 intent.
